column1: # Voice Kit rules. One rule per line: id <TAB> regex <TAB> why. Checked on every .kt file under src/main/java of EVERY module (oskit, os, programs/*, adapters) except voicekit/.
# Read by the Gradle task checkVoiceKit (runs before every build) and by KitRulesTest. Comment lines in the code are skipped.
# "allow" lines: allow <TAB> file-name <TAB> rule id <TAB> why. Keep this list tiny.

column3: Speaking is the kit's: use VoiceKit.narrator.say(Phrase)
Playing sound is the kit's: use VoiceKit.narrator.beep or cue
Audio focus and stream playing are the kit's
The button comes in only through the kit (VoiceKit.mediaKeys, VoiceKit.buttons)
Fixed sentences are made only inside the kit (Sentences.kt)
A plain text in Phrase.content is a fixed sentence in disguise: add it to Sentences.kt
Spoken sentences come from Sentences.kt, not from a string
Every list is a kit Scanner
Collapsing or splitting white space is logickit/Text.kt: use squash() or words()
